 Coram:

Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order

No. 13.09.2024  02.
 1.
The petitioner is an accused in connection with Erasama P.S. Case No.357 of 2023 corresponding to Special G.R. Case No.59 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 376(1)/292/292(2)(a) of the IPC read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act read with Sections 66E/67a of the I.T. Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Court under POCSO Act,
Jagatsinghpur.
The petitioner had approached the learned Additional District Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Jagatsinghpur in Special G.R. Case No.59 of 2023 praying for grant of bail.
The learned Court below vide its order dated 18.03.2024 rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the present petition to renew his bail plea after the victim is examined in the present case.

5. With the aforementioned observation, the BLAPL is disposed of.
